## Plane Crash Example 
<https://www.planecrashinfo.com/2025/2025.htm> 

```{r tidy_tc_crashes}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# What we learned last class is tha tif I were t read this as an HTML table, I haveno contorl on what goes into each column in the resulting data frame -- this makes cleanig it (extracting text from it more challenging) 

crash_page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(1) > font > a") |> 
  rvest::html_text2() -> dates 

crash_page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(2) > font") |> 
  rvest::html_text2() -> loc_op
# Skipped col 3 exactly similar for the time purposes 

crash_page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(4) > font") |> 
  rvest::html_text2() -> fatalities

df = data.frame(dates = dates, loc = loc_op[-1], fatalities = fatalities[-1]) |>
  tidyr::separate(loc, into = c("location", "operator"), sep = "\n") |>
  tidyr::separate(fatalities, into = c("plane_fatalities", "pass", "ground_fatalities"))
# this is tidy but not technically correct 
dplyr::glimpse(df) 

```
